name: Rain Reader: LiE oR DiE
source:
You have been selected for this job due to your unique qualifications as a being desperate to stay alive. You want to stay alive, yes?

[From [url=https://portrait-prophecies.itch.io/lie-or-die]Itch.io[/url]]
